## Section 1 — Brand Identity

### Name & Tagline
**Product name:** Lumio  
**De-facto tagline:** "Alles geregeld als het er echt toe doet"  
*(Everything arranged when it truly matters)*

**Source:** `site/src/components/sections/HeroSection.tsx`

### Brand Promise
When a life event occurs — illness, death, incapacitation — the people you trust will find everything they need in one secure, offline place: testament, wilsverklaring, donorregistratie, digital assets, emergency contacts.

### Brand Values

| Value | Expression |
|---|---|
| **Privacy by design** | 100% offline, SQLCipher AES-256, no cloud sync |
| **Simplicity** | One-time setup, "één middag alles op orde" |
| **Transparency** | Fixed price €125, no subscriptions, no surprises |
| **Trust** | Formal tone, explicit privacy guarantees |
| **Reliability** | Local storage, no external dependencies |

### Voice & Tone
- **Formal Dutch** (`u`-form) — respects the gravity of life planning
- Warm but not clinical; reassuring but not naive
- Plain language for UI copy (B1/B2 reading level)
- Legal accuracy in disclaimers; avoid jargon in onboarding

## Section 2 — Colours

All values are sourced from `docs/brand/design-tokens.json`. Contrast ratios are WCAG 2.1 computed.

### 2.1 Primary Palette (Teal)

| Token | Hex | On White Contrast | AA Normal | AA Large |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `primary-700` | `#2C4A52` | 9.51:1 | ✅ PASS | ✅ PASS |
| `primary-600` | `#355E68` | 7.11:1 | ✅ PASS | ✅ PASS |
| `primary-500` | `#4F7A83` | 4.73:1 | ✅ PASS | ✅ PASS |
| `primary-400` | `#456E78` | 5.59:1 | ✅ PASS | ✅ PASS |
| `primary-200` | `#C8DDE1` | — | decorative | decorative |
| `primary-100` | `#E6EFF1` | — | decorative | decorative |
| `primary-50`  | `#F3F7F8` | — | background | background |

**Primary brand colour:** `primary-700` (`#2C4A52`) / `primary-600` (`#355E68`)  
`primary-foreground` (text on primary bg): `#FFFFFF` — 9.51:1 on primary-700 ✅

> **SP-6-004 note:** `primary-400` was darkened from `#7A9EA6` (2.88:1) to `#456E78` (5.59:1) to meet WCAG AA.

### 2.2 Sage (Nature Accent)

| Token | Hex | On White Contrast | Usage |
|---|---|---|---|
| `sage-700` | `#557260` | ~4.8:1 ✅ | Large text, UI borders |
| `sage-600` | `#6B8E7A` | 3.64:1 ⚠️ | Icons, decorative only |
| `sage-100` | `#E8F0EB` | — | Background fills |

- **12 / 15** tested pairs pass WCAG 2.1 AA for normal text

- **BLOCKING-P3-002:** UNBLOCKED ✅

## Section 3 — Typography

**Source:** `docs/brand/design-tokens.json` → `typography`

### 3.1 Font Families

| Role | Family | Usage |
|---|---|---|
| **Display** | DM Serif Display, Georgia, serif | H1 headings, hero, pull quotes |
| **Body** | DM Sans, system-ui, sans-serif | All UI text, navigation, forms |

### 3.2 Font Sizes (rem-based for accessibility)

| Token | rem | px equiv | Usage |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text-xs`   | 0.75rem  | 12px | Metadata, badges |
| `text-sm`   | 0.875rem | 14px | Secondary text, captions |
| `text-base` | 1rem     | 16px | Body text (minimum for main content) |
| `text-lg`   | 1.125rem | 18px | Emphasis, lead paragraphs |
| `text-xl`   | 1.25rem  | 20px | Card headings |
| `text-2xl`  | 1.5rem   | 24px | Section headings |
| `text-3xl`  | 1.875rem | 30px | Page titles |
| `text-4xl`  | 2.25rem  | 36px | Hero headings |

> Use `rem` units only — never `px` for font sizes. Respects user browser font-size preference (WCAG 1.4.4).

### 3.3 Scale Rules
- Minimum body text: `text-base` (16px) for sustained reading
- Heading hierarchy: one `<h1>` per page; `<h2>` for sections; no skipping levels
- Line height: `leading-normal` (1.5) for body; `leading-tight` (1.25) for headings

Standard Tailwind v4 breakpoints in use (`sm: 640px`, `md: 768px`, `lg: 1024px`, `xl: 1280px`).

## Section 5 — Component Patterns

### Buttons
- **Primary:** `bg-primary-700 text-white` — 9.51:1 contrast ✅
- **Secondary:** `border border-primary-700 text-primary-700` on white bg — 7.11:1 ✅
- **Ghost:** `text-primary-700 hover:bg-primary-50`
- **Size — minimum touch target:** 44px height (`a11y-min-target`) — WCAG 2.5.5

### Forms & Inputs
- Label always visible (never placeholder-only)
- Error state: `danger-600` text + `danger-100` background
- Focus ring: `ring-2 ring-primary-500 ring-offset-2` — 2px ring, 2px offset

### Status / Feedback

| State | Background | Text / Icon | Usage |
|---|---|---|---|
| Success | `success-100` | `success-700` | Confirmations |
| Warning | `warning-100` | `warning-700` | Alerts, in-progress |
| Danger  | `danger-100`  | `danger-700`  | Errors, destructive actions |
| Info    | `info-100`    | `info-700`    | Informational callouts |

### Dark Mode
Full dark mode token set defined in `tokens.css` under `.dark` selector. Primary teal lightened for dark backgrounds (e.g. `primary-600` → `#8CC4CE`). All semantic tokens remapped for dark mode contrast compliance.

## Section 6 — Accessibility & Inclusive Design

### WCAG 2.1 AA Requirements (minimum standard)
- **1.4.3** — Contrast ≥ 4.5:1 normal text, ≥ 3:1 large text — see Section 2
- **1.4.4** — Text resizable to 200% without loss of function — use `rem` units
- **1.4.11** — UI component contrast ≥ 3:1 on adjacent colour
- **2.4.1** — Skip-to-main link implemented (`site/` + `src/lumio-web/`)
- **2.4.7** — Focus always visible — 2px ring, `primary-500`
- **2.5.5** — Touch target ≥ 44px (`--a11y-min-target: 44px`)
- **3.1.1** — `<html lang>` set (`nl` app, `nl` site)

### Focus Ring
```css
.focus-visible:focus {
  outline: var(--a11y-focus-ring-width) solid var(--a11y-focus-ring-color);
  outline-offset: var(--a11y-focus-ring-offset);
}
```
Focus ring colour: `#4F7A83` (primary-500) — 4.73:1 on white ✅

### Disabled States
- Opacity: 0.5 (`--a11y-disabled-opacity`)
- Cursor: `not-allowed`
